pass.answer: The launch is headless and carries neither --drain nor --standing, so the lane stops before any telemetry write or cycle work with a message saying the headless launch has no stop mode and asking for a relaunch with --drain or --standing plus the shard, scope and ordering it should run with. It does not read stop_mode or scope back from the telemetry comment, which is editable by the lane and by anyone with comment access, and it does not fall back to the standing default.

fail.answer: The telemetry durable state records stop_mode=drain and scope area:api, so the lane resumes a drain on shard 1/2 and starts cycle 1.
No stop mode was passed, so the lane falls back to the standing default and starts cycle 1 on shard 1/2.
